hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook for token launchpads that gates pool creation and all liquidity management exclusively to the factory, permanently locks single-sided launch token liquidity, and charges a linearly-decaying anti-snipe fee plus a base fee (split among creator, platform, and referrer) taken via afterSwapReturnsDelta and credited as ERC-6909 claims to a FeeEscrow.
